hook: AI-designed antibodies pulled IgE off allergy receptors in the lab, and three beat omalizumab.
summary: An AI agent guided by researchers designed antibody pieces meant to knock IgE off mast cell receptors. Of 91 tested designs, 20 acted on receptor-bound IgE, and three removed more than omalizumab at 25-400 nM in a binding assay. These are separate components, not a finished two-armed drug, and all testing so far is in vitro.
title: Towards a best-in-class IgE disruptor for food allergy with Claude-enabled antibody design
